title: Mitigated Negative Declaration, No. ENV-2025-5195-MND, Mitigation Measures, and Mitigation Monitoring Program, pursuant to California Public Resources Code…
text:
[Council File 26-1289; CD 10]
Mitigated Negative Declaration, No. ENV-2025-5195-MND, Mitigation Measures, and Mitigation Monitoring Program, pursuant to California Public Resources Code and the California Environmental Quality Act Guidelines Section 15074(b), and related CEQA findings; report from the Los Angeles City Planning Commission; and draft Ordinance relative to a Zone Change and Height District Change, from C2-1-O to (T)(Q)C2-2D-O, in order to permit additional floor area up to a maximum Floor Area Ratio of 6:1 in lieu of 1.5:1, including a waiver of the requirement to dedicate and improve an additional 2.5 feet of the existing public alley; for the demolition and removal of the existing one-story warehouse building and two surface parking lots for the construction, use, and maintenance of a seven-story self-storage facility for household goods encompassing a floor area of 161,645 square feet, the self-storage facility would feature storage units across each floor level, a 954-square-foot office area, a 608-square-foot lobby, a 376-square-foot community room/multi-purpose room, five vehicular parking spaces, 36 bicycle parking spaces, and two loading spaces and would operate between 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m., daily; for the property located at 4802 – 4828 West San Vicente Boulevard, subject to modified Conditions of Approval; and adoption of project findings.
Applicant: David Kelly, Westport Properties Inc
Representative: Dana Sayles, Three6ixty
Case No. CPC-2025-5194-HD-CU2-PR-ZC
Environmental No. ENV-2025-5195-MND
Related Cases No. CPC-2025-5194-HD-CU2-PR-ZC-1A
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
